# js-yaml 4.1.1

The unmodified standalone CommonJS/UMD distribution is vendored so installed
Forgeflow helpers can read YAML without a separate npm install. Its MIT license
is included in LICENSE.

Upstream sources:

- https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/blob/4.1.1/dist/js-yaml.js
- https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/blob/4.1.1/LICENSE

Update the pinned distribution and license together, then run the vault format
and installation tests. Forgeflow applies its own bounded metadata validation.
